cases.note: the profile's file: the current revision

document.$comment: desired.v1's standard schema (spec/profiles/desired/v1.md §2.10, §3; core §10 point 1). A target's contract lists this file, or a copy whose JCS bytes are equal, and types its report desired.v1.Report: a type is the profile's by this artifact's id, never by its name alone. Objects are open: a later minor may add a member, and a reader ignores one it does not know. Descriptions and comments are annotations (core §7.3).

desired.v1.Refusal.description: Why a target refused a document, or failed to apply it (§2.10): a code, the profile's (undecodable, reach, sensitive, invalid, apply) or the type's own, where in the document as a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901), and a line for a person.

desired.v1.Report.description: What a target holds of one desired document, put by the target as its own state (§2.10): what is in force, and the last version it acted on with that act's outcome.

in_force.description: The version wholly in force, with source desired only. Absent after a failed act, when no one version is.

key.description: The document's key, base-relative (core §1.6): the target's slice of its author's template (§2.3). Absent only for a requirement left unbound, the kill switch (§2.12).

last_known.description: true when the observed version was read from an archive, its author absent or silent (§2.9). Absent is false.

observed.description: The last version the target acted on in this instance, whatever the outcome (§2.7). Absent before its first act.

outcome.description: What that act did (§2.7, §2.8): converged, the document in force; refused, nothing of it applied and what was in force kept; failed, applied in part; reverted, a delete acted on and the baseline back in force.

refusal.description: Why, with refused or failed only.

source.description: What is in force (§2.10): baseline, the target's own configuration with no document; desired, a document the target acted on; call, a change the target's own operation made since.

desired.v1.Version.description: One version of a document (§2.4): its author's stamp, as zenoh writes a timestamp (the NTP64 time in decimal, a slash, the id in lowercase hexadecimal without leading zeros), and the document's own revision when its type carries one. A delete's version has no revision.

cases.note: a copy, inline: JCS-equal, so the same id and the profile's types
a desired.v1.Report in another artifact is not the profile's, whatever its name (core §7.1)

description: desired.v1 §2.10, §3: the standard schema's published artifact ids. file is the profile's schema, a path relative to this profile's directory, and current its artifact's id: sha256 over the document's JCS bytes (RFC 8785; core §7.1, §9.4), as sha256:<64 lowercase hex>. published lists every id the profile publishes, oldest first, each with the text that published it; a type of an artifact whose id is listed is the profile's. types are the profile's type names, each a $defs member of every published revision that defines it (since: the first revision that does). Each case names a document, by path (relative to the repository's root), or inline (document) -> expect.id, its artifact id, and expect.published, whether that id is listed.
